Execute.SQL: SELECT e.EventId, e.SourceSystem, e.EventType, ISNULL(e.ChildEventTypes, '') AS ChildEventTypes, e.OffenderId, p.Mrn, p.LastName, p.FirstName, ISNULL(p.MiddleName, '') AS MiddleName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), p.BirthDate, 112) AS BirthDate, p.Sex, p.Street, p.City, p.State, p.Zip, ISNULL(p.Phone, '') AS Phone, e.FacilityCode, ISNULL(e.UnitCode, '') AS UnitCode, ISNULL(e.BedCode, '') AS BedCode, ISNULL(e.PriorFacilityCode, '') AS PriorFacilityCode, ISNULL(e.PriorUnitCode, '') AS PriorUnitCode, ISNULL(e.PriorBedCode, '') AS PriorBedCode, ISNULL(e.AttendingNpi, '') AS AttendingNpi, ISNULL(e.AttendingName, '') AS AttendingName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), e.EventTimestamp, 126) AS EventTimestamp, e.Status, ISNULL(e.Notes, '') AS Notes FROM dbo.OperationalEvents e INNER JOIN dbo.Patients p ON p.OffenderId = e.OffenderId WHERE e.Status = N'PENDING' ORDER BY e.EventId
